title: Revealing Structured Heterogeneity
abstract: arXiv:2610.20441v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we study models of restricted heterogeneity. While the random utility model allows for arbitrary heterogeneity among rational types, we consider the case when an analyst ex-ante restricts the set of rational types to some smaller set of allowable types. We study the behavioral content, the model fit, and the identification properties of restrictions of this form. We find that all three of these can be connected through a common value function that is constructed from observable data. Consistency with a model of restricted heterogeneity is characterized by this value function achieving a value of one, while model fit is given by a value that is potentially less than one. The partially identified set for a given model of restricted heterogeneity is characterized by way of the subdifferential of this value function.

translated_abstract: 本文研究了受限异质性模型。随机效用模型允许理性类型之间存在任意的异质性，而本文考虑的是分析者事先将理性类型的集合限制为某个更小的允许类型集合的情形。我们研究了此类限制的行为内容、模型拟合度以及可识别性性质。我们发现，这三者可以通过一个由可观测数据构建的共同价值函数联系起来。与受限异质性模型的相容性由该价值函数取值为1来刻画，而模型拟合度则由一个可能小于1的值给出。给定受限异质性模型的偏识别集则通过该价值函数的次微分来刻画。
tldr: 本文提出一个由可观测数据构建的统一价值函数，将受限异质性模型的行为内容刻画、模型拟合度衡量与偏识别集的确定三者联系起来。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified value function constructed from observable data that simultaneously characterizes behavioral content, model fit, and the partially identified set of restricted heterogeneity models.
